Privacy Policy

Submittable Filter — Chrome Extension
Last updated: March 29, 2026

Summary

Submittable Filter does not collect, transmit, or share any personal data. Everything stays on your computer.

What data the extension stores

The extension stores your filter settings (blocked publication names, blocked keywords, submission type preferences) and a list of publication names detected on the Submittable Discover page along with their posting frequency. This data is stored locally on your device using Chrome's built-in storage API (chrome.storage.local).

What data the extension does NOT collect

The extension does not collect or transmit any personal information, browsing history, Submittable account credentials, submission content, or any other data. It does not communicate with any external servers. It does not use analytics, tracking, cookies, or any third-party services.

Where data is stored

All data is stored locally on your device and never leaves your browser. If you uninstall the extension, all stored data is deleted automatically.

Permissions

The extension requires only the storage permission (to save your filter settings) and access to manager.submittable.com/opportunities/discover pages (to detect and filter listings). It does not request access to any other websites.

Third parties

This extension does not share data with any third parties. There are no analytics services, advertising networks, or data brokers involved.

Changes to this policy

If this privacy policy changes, the updated version will be posted at this URL. The extension does not auto-update its privacy policy.

Contact

Questions about this policy can be directed to the developer via rcblenis.com.

Open source

The extension's source code is publicly available at github.com/rcolinb/rcolinb.github.io.
